Name: Quaint Living - Artisan Goods
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][line]
Quaint Living - Artisan Good is a production mod that adds artisan goods productions and craftings into the game. Compatible with both vanilla and Quaint Living (QL) items.[/center][line]
[img=centre]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24808/24808-1717677377-1738351474.png[/img]

This mod adds:

[b]ARTISAN GOODS[/b]

[b]Candied Flowers[/b]
Requires 1 edible flowers put inside Preserve Jar
Vanilla: Fairy Rose, Sunflower, Tulip
QL: Carnation, Gardenia, Hibiscus, Jasmine, Lavender, Lilac, Pansy, Peony, Rose

[b]Extracts[/b]
Requires 10 aromatic flowers put into Extractor machine. (Jasmine requires 35)
Vanilla: Fairy Rose, Poppy
QL: Carnation, Gardenia, Hibiscus, Jasmine, Lavender, Lilac, Rose

[b]Flower Wine[/b]
Requires 1 edible and aromatic flower put into Floral Keg.
Vanilla: Fairy Rose, Poppy
QL: Carnation, Gardenia, Hibiscus, Lavender, Lilac, Rose

[b]Bouquets[/b] 
Requires 3 flowers, Florist Table
Vanilla: Blue Jazz, Fairy Rose, Poppy, Summer Spangle, Sunflower, Tulip, Crocus, Daffodil, Sweet Pea
QL: Amaryllis, Calla Lily, Dahlia, Delphinium, Fritillaria, Iris, Lily, Orchid, Pansy, Peony, Rose, Snapdragon, Striped Squill, Zinnia, Gardenia, Lilac


[b]CRAFTING & MACHINES[/b]

[b]Florist Paper[/b] 
Unlocked at Farming lvl 3
Requires 3 wood, used for crafting bouquet at Florist Table.

[b]Extractor[/b] 
Unlocked at Farming lvl 10
Requires coal as fuel.
Can also be puchased at Dwaft at 6 hearts

[b]Floral Keg[/b]
Unlocked after Linus gives farmer the blueprint. Event conditions: Reach 6H with Linus, go to the Mountain when it's raining between 8pm to 12pm.
Can also be purchased at Travelling Merchant at Sundays.

[b]Florist Table[/b]
Unlocked at Farming lvl 3
Requires florist paper as fuel.


[b]FUTURE PLANS[/b]

Compatibility with other mods
More stuff
